summary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into two industrial building lease agreements (Buildings 4 and 5) with Hightower Phase II Owner, LLC, an affiliate of its existing Phase I landlord. The leases are for newly constructed manufacturing and warehouse space in Houston, Texas, each with a 120-month initial term, annual rent escalations, and tenant responsibility for 100% of operating costs, taxes, and insurance. Construction is anticipated substantially complete in about 16 months, with rent abatement if delayed beyond 18 months and a tenant termination option after 24 months. This is a routine operational lease commitment, not a special situation.
